video_title: What REALLY HAPPENED in Minnesota! Pat Bev goes behind-the-scenes of this INFAMOUS Moment! NBA

quotes.speaker: Patrick Beverley
quotes.summary_phrase: Patrick Beverley on the Clippers' unexpected playoff run with rookies
quotes.excerpt: People didn't even count us to win 30 games. We made the playoffs
quotes.quote: I was with the Clippers maybe four or five years. I was with the Clippers before Paul George and Kawhi Leonard. Obviously I was a part of that Chris Paul trade, so I was with the Clippers during times where people didn't even count us to win 30 games. And we made the playoffs. We made the playoffs with two rookies, Shai Gilgeous-Alexander and Landry Shamet. We played against arguably the best team that ever played basketball in the Golden State Warriors.

quotes.speaker: Patrick Beverley
quotes.summary_phrase: Patrick Beverley on turning down more money to stay with the Clippers
quotes.excerpt: I turned down a three-year $50 million with Sacramento just to stay with the Clippers
quotes.quote: I signed a three-year $40 million contract with the Clippers. I turned down a three-year $50 million with Sacramento just to stay with the Clippers. For me to be there, all the great guards they've had, I was part of that starting five that helped the Clippers go to the first time ever Western Conference Finals. They've had great guards. They've had James Harden, they had Russell Westbrook, they have Chris Paul, they've had Rajon Rondo. They had a plethora of point guards that just can never help them get over the hump, but I was part of that starting five that helped them finally, first time ever, and they haven't been back since, get to the Western Conference Finals.

quotes.speaker: Patrick Beverley
quotes.summary_phrase: Patrick Beverley on his contract negotiations with the Clippers
quotes.excerpt: I called Kawhi, and then they called me back down
quotes.quote: The no was like four to five million dollars total for one year. I left the meeting, I called Kawhi, and then they called me back down and my agent said they lifted it up to six to eight million. And then I'm like, okay, well I definitely want to go for sure, because why do you need to call Kawhi for anything when I've been here the longest?

quotes.speaker: Thanasis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Thanasis Antetokounmpo on Kawhi Leonard's influence on contract negotiations
quotes.excerpt: 3.4 million up because of a phone call
quotes.quote: I want to say something about that, because you know how I always view it too. You're saying from a standpoint like, yo, I've been here the longest, now you're asking him, and he's validating. But to be honest with you, isn't that a superstar saying like, I want him? Let's say example, Kawhi would have called him, and there was still they give you the same offer, you would have been like, he doesn't matter. Like, he does matter. The reason I say that is because they specifically were like, no, Kawhi wants him. Now okay, they couldn't get it done. But Kawhi definitely wanted you, and that 3.4 million up because of a phone call.

quotes.speaker: Patrick Beverley
quotes.summary_phrase: Patrick Beverley on his successful tenure with the Minnesota Timberwolves
quotes.excerpt: I got double what I asked for
quotes.quote: I go to Minnesota. Minnesota gave me extension of $13 million. So not only I doubled it with Minnesota. I don't think people understand this. That starting five we had in Minnesota was arguably probably the best starting five offensively and defensively in the NBA that year. A historic number offensively and defensively. Me, D'Angelo Russell, Anthony Edwards, Jarred Vanderbilt, Karl-Anthony Towns. It was arguably we had the top starting five offensively and defense in the NBA for a large body of work. They saw what I've been trying to show people and what I do to organizations all the time, that I give them a little juice.

quotes.speaker: Patrick Beverley
quotes.summary_phrase: Patrick Beverley on the Timberwolves' playoff drought and his impact
quotes.excerpt: They haven't missed the playoffs since I got there
quotes.quote: The first team we play against is the Clippers, and if we win, the Minnesota gets into the playoffs after 16 years. Jimmy Butler has been there, Derrick Rose has been there, all these different players have been there, high-level players, all-star, Jeff Teague, all-star caliber type players, and Minnesota has never been there. And then you inject Pat Bev in there and we're playing with a number seven seed. So not only did it was the emotional time for me, you know, I had family there, you know, and I really put on for the city of Minnesota. They haven't missed the playoffs since I got there. Two Western Conference Finals. They haven't missed the playoffs from me being there until now, they have not missed the playoffs.

quotes.speaker: Patrick Beverley
quotes.summary_phrase: Patrick Beverley on knowing he belonged in the NBA
quotes.excerpt: I was just picking guys up full court
quotes.quote: I kind of knew I belonged once I left out of college and I went to these UCLA runs. They had some runs in LA and I was just picking guys up full court, and they didn't like it. I knew like, okay, cool, I'm picking up Jordan Farmar, I'm picking up Jannero Pargo. These aren't caliber NBA names but they are NBA players. If I can do that and kind of lean my hat on that, I know once I get in the door I'll be okay. I just didn't know when.

quotes.speaker: Patrick Beverley
quotes.summary_phrase: Patrick Beverley on his early career in Greece
quotes.excerpt: We were all the same age
quotes.quote: Kostas Papanikolaou, Sloukas, we were all the same age. You talk about captains of some of the best European powerhouses to ever play basketball. We were all the same age. We practiced against each other out of practice, so my Greece ties go very deep.
